card.name: Capital T starting Ti- or Ti-type words
card.fires_on: A separated capital T (or t) that begins a word such as Tilt, Tidal, Tightly, Timing or Titration, often at the start of a numbered instruction step. The word is split so the T stands alone before the rest.

modes.label: T at start of instruction step
modes.description: A lone T opens a numbered or sentence-initial directions step like Tilt or Tightly.

modes.description: A T that starts a split term such as Tidal Breathing or Timing in a table heading.
